author: Retro Game Corps
description:
MSI's new Claw 8 EX AI+ handheld improves on its predecessors in just about every way, with performance that feels like a true generational leap. Among the upcoming handheld PCs I've tested at COMPUTEX this year, this one is easily the most impressive.  Let's take a look.

More info: https://www.msi.com/Handheld/Claw-8-EX-AI-Plus-CG3XMX

** Note: I mentioned "FSR" a few times in the video, I meant to say "XeSS" (Intel's upscaling technology).
